feedback.intro: Report a bug, an idea or unsafe content to the Prayer.Tools team. For questions about this campaign or typos in its content, please use the Contact page.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Choose when you want to pray and we will send you a reminder by email at that time, with a link to the day's prayer guide. Pray for as long as you can: every prayer counts. You can change your prayer times or stop at any time.

signup.title: Sign up to pray
signup.intro: Join others praying with {site}. Choose a time and we will remind you.

share.title: Invite others to pray
share.body: Prayer grows when friends pray together. Share this campaign with someone who would join you.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions about this campaign, or found a typo in the prayer guide? Send us a message.

app.title: Pray with the app
app.body: Get reminders on your phone and pray even when you are offline.

home.title: Prayer campaigns for the places and peoples you care about
home.intro: Set up a campaign, invite people to pray, and cover every hour with daily prayer content and reminders.
home.coverage_body: People choose times to pray so no hour of the day or night is left uncovered.
home.content_body: Guided prayer for each day, ready to use or written by your team.
home.reminders_body: Everyone praying gets an email or app reminder at the times they chose.
